en.summary: Newborn jaundice (yellow eyes/skin) is common and often settles in ~2 weeks. NHS: emergency care if jaundice with sleepiness/hard to wake, not feeding, floppy/stiff/jerks, fever or very low temp, no wet nappies, breathing difficulty, or age <24 hours. Encourage regular feeds; treatment (e.g. phototherapy) is clinician-led — not prescribed here.
emergencyIf: Jaundice and sleepier than normal / difficult to wake
High temperature ≥38°C or low ≤36°C / hot-cold / shivering
Difficulty breathing / grunting / very fast breathing
Baby less than 24 hours old with jaundice
seeDoctorIf: Feeding difficulties or unsure feeds are enough
selfCare: Encourage regular feeds (~8–12/day); wake sleepy babies for feeds if advised
doNot: Do not invent phototherapy or bilirubin thresholds
Do not delay if baby <24h with jaundice

fr.summary: L'ictère néonatal est fréquent et s'améliore souvent en ~2 semaines. Urgence si somnolence, non-alimentation, hypotonie/raideur/secousses, fièvre/hypothermie, pas de couches mouillées, détresse, âge <24 h.

he.summary: צהבת ביילודים נפוצה ולרוב חולפת תוך כשבועיים. חירום אם ישנוניות, לא אוכל, רפיון/נוקשות/עוויתות, חום/היפותרמיה, ללא חיתולים רטובים, קושי נשימה, או גיל <24 שעות.

ru.summary: Желтуха новорождённых часта и часто проходит за ~2 недели. Неотложка при сонливости, отказе от еды, вялости/скованности/подёргиваниях, лихорадке/гипотермии, отсутствии мокрых подгузников, одышке, возрасте <24 ч.
